title: Monthly Travel Spend and Distance Rollup
dataSources: ADS-B aircraft snapshots (`adsb:aircraft`), personal flight logbook (`flight:log`), commute trips (`commute:trip`), transit arrivals (`transit:arrival`), geofence events (`geofence:event`), travel documents (`travel:document`), fare quotes (`airprice:quote`).
app: Home ADS-B receiver (dump1090 / readsb / tar1090 JSON feed), personal flight logbook exports, commute/transit APIs, and phone geofence webhooks via Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal (sourcetype=commute:trip OR sourcetype=flight:log)
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(cost) as spend, sum(distance_km) as km, count as trips by _time
| eval cost_per_km=round(spend/km,2)
| sort - _time
description: Combines your commutes and flights into a monthly view of what travel costs you and how far it takes you.
value: Seeing travel spend and distance together each month exposes an expensive habit and makes the cost-per-kilometre trade-off concrete.
implementation: Ingest trips and flights with cost and distance; schedule monthly and review spend, distance, and cost per kilometre.
visualization: Column chart of monthly travel spend with a distance overlay.
grandmaExplanation: It adds up what you spend getting around each month and how far you travel, so the real cost of moving about is clear.
